description: Price history for one coin as candles: open, high, low, close and volume per interval (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d), up to 500, oldest first, from Hyperliquid's public market, the same prices the sandbox trades at. Use to look back at price action, find recent highs and lows for a stop, or judge the trend. Not for the live best price (use compare_perp_quotes_across_venues) or ready-made indicators (use get_technical_indicators_15m). Inputs: symbol (base coin), interval (default 1h), limit (default 100). Prices in USD per coin, volume in the base coin, times UTC. Next: size_position_by_risk.
